name: TensorRT-LLM: LLM inference on NVIDIA GPUs
notes: TensorRT-LLM provides Python API for defining LLMs with state-of-the-art optimizations for NVIDIA GPUs. Contains Python and C++ runtimes. Supports FP8, FP4 quantization. 14.8k stars. Works with NVIDIA Dynamo for datacenter-scale serving. Includes Triton backend and Triton kernels.
